findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_listings" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search Minedo Listings (homes for the school year) near a School or a point in Greece. Filter by radius, maximum monthly base price, bedrooms, furnished, floor …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "search_listings" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
